scope: Offline Control Center, document, OCR and native scanner software verification

Request forgery protection and session rotation
Actual multipage neural OCR and searchable PDF text
Page selection, rotation, crop, merge and image output
Durable request identifiers, queued input retention and restart recovery
Held print preparation with a recording transport
Isolated SANE virtual scanner acquisition and shared locking
Durable next-page sessions, original retention and revision conflict handling
Actual ordered multipage PDF output and optional OCR
Queued and running cancellation without repeating scanner work
Lost response and page reload reuse the accepted operation
Explicit new operation after a known response gets a new identifier

Feedback and paper choices update with the selected language

Saved scanner settings restore after delayed discovery without overwriting subsequent choices
Physical millimetres to actual scanner arguments
Real output pixel dimensions at a different resolution
